goals: Restores six reachable slot-specific enchantment writes for equipment updated by Matcha 1.12.5.
scope: Adapts six publisher-supplied writers to 26.2, directs the offhand write to the offhand and clears held scratch storage after writes and on load. All 146 call sites and all 78 same-name recipe overlaps are checked.

exclusions: Smithing recipe edits, unrelated equipment changes and migration to Minecraft 26.3.

dependencies.reason: Command parser, item modifiers and equipment slots used by the writers.
The six missing functions are specific to this generation.
